note: v4 repaint 2026-10-22 (s04 track): dining hall, cream plaster, dark wainscot, oak floor, brass chandelier landmark. Kitchen exit is ONE wide pair of swinging porthole doors standing half open on the kitchen (stove, copper pans, steam). Bar shelves hold plates, jam jars and a copper coffee urn: no bottles anywhere (children present, no alcohol words). Duck/le plat moved to the bar zoom. Divider at the centre column (x=540): feminine left, masculine right. 10 items.

items.label: la commande
items.scene: A small boy points like a general, 'I COMMAND!' (koh-MAHND), while the waitress writes his ORDER on her notepad.

items.label: l'addition
items.scene: A waiter ADDS each DISH ON (ah-dee-SYOHN) to a very long paper strip: THE BILL, curling down towards the rabbit's table.

items.label: la crudité
items.scene: A white rabbit nibbles a platter of CRUDITÉS (krew-dee-TAY), RAW carrot and celery sticks with a pot of dip.

items.label: le restaurant
items.scene: A smiling host in a bow tie welcomes a mother, father and small son: 'REST, oh, you RAN so far!' (rehs-toh-RAHN) Welcome to the RESTAURANT.

items.label: le serveur
items.scene: A WAITER SWERVES (sehr-VUHR) between the tables with a plate of food held high in each hand.

items.label: le dessert
items.scene: A little girl at her table gazes up at a towering chocolate DESSERT (day-SEHR) with a cherry on top.

items.label: le menu
items.scene: A grandfather peers at a huge MENU card through a magnifying glass, hunting for 'MORE NEW' dishes (muh-NEW).

items.label: le pourboire
items.scene: A POOR BOAR (poor-BWAHR) in a patched waiter's jacket beams as a lady drops a little TIP into the cup he holds out.

items.label: le resto
items.scene: A tired hiker slumps in her chair to REST (rehs-TOH), boots off and backpack down, in this cosy little RESTO.

items.label: le couvert
items.scene: A bear lays a PLACE SETTING, fork, knife and plate, and pops a silver COVER (koo-VEHR) over the plate.
